answer: An agent marketplace requires each active seller to lock 100 units of an external currency in escrow for 30 days; the same funds cannot back two accounts. Whether agents sell umber pigment, sparrow sketches, or marble, opening 1,000 seller identities therefore ties up 100,000 units. Fake names remain cheap, but usable accounts consume scarce capital and impose financing costs, so multiplying identities does not multiply access for free.
